name: Analysis of Chemicals and Finished Textiles Lab
description: Analysis of alkali mixture. Evaluation of the strength of hydrogen peroxide. Evaluation and standardization of dyes. Identification of dyes on the dyed substrate. Evaluation of finished textiles.
